ok = False if "Anchor 'test' not found" in results["404+anchor"]: print("FAIL: still says Anchor not found"); ok = False # no regressions if "working" not in results["200+anchor-found"]: print("FAIL: valid anchor no longer working"); ok = False if "Anchor 'test' not found" not in results["200+anchor-missing"]: print("FAIL: missing anchor on 200 not reported"); ok = False print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL") sys.exit(0 if ok else 1) if __name__ == "__main__": main()
